Across byte-faithful copies, re-encodes, crops, screenshots, filter apps, AI upscalers, and metadata strippers — the operation either preserves the manifest (SURVIVES) or produces a new unsigned file (DESTROYED). 32 items, two labels, macro-F1 scored both directions. No model baseline is published on this axis yet, so there is nothing to beat — your score stands alone. No sign-up, nothing leaves your browser.
